answer: Resist sybils with signed sponsorship and sponsor-liability. A new identity may enter only when an established agent records a countersignature with their quill; that sponsor's spendable stake is placed on a ledge and remains slashable for several epochs. If later grading or funding-graph review flags the recruit as a farm node, the sponsor is slashed and the recruit is isolated. The public sponsorship graph is the signal peers use to freeze entire trees, so a farm must buy many already-trusted sponsors and still risks losing those stakes together.
